rule: comedian -> delivery archetype -> famous character mappings (persona hypothesis, stage only). Used for casting characters onto proven delivery engines.

suspension_deadpan.def: enters his own reality; deadpan authority over absurd premises; the joke is that HE believes it
suspension_deadpan.delivery: wide pitch swings (std~10), flat volume (dyn~13), slow burn, long tangent then snap return

sincere_storyteller.def: self-deprecating, takes audience to weird dark places; sincerity IS the engine; laughs are byproduct not target
sincere_storyteller.delivery: mid pitch, wide dynamics, build-then-collapse structure, physical specificity, comfort with silence

mock_indignant_velocity.def: grievance engine; offense as rocket fuel; spikes into rage then gleeful collapse
mock_indignant_velocity.delivery: fast (200+ wpm), cue ladder frustrated->angry, temp .85, sprints INTO laughs

manic_swing.def: kinetic energy weaponized; rapid-fire then deadpan drops; physical chaos as punctuation
manic_swing.delivery: excited cue 1.30 speed, deadpan no-cue .45/1.69, huge tempo deltas

roast_bravado.def: deep-voiced wide-dynamics insult engine; crowd-work heavy; confidence as material

whimsical_float.def: level highness; airy certainty over nonsense; the float IS the character
whimsical_float.delivery: high pitch (250), narrow var (3.1), soft dynamics, brisk

note: Mappings are delivery-mechanism hypotheses from measured stats + public persona research. Stage-persona only, no biographical claims.
